hi123@gmail.com.title: Veg burger recipe
hi123@gmail.com.output:
Looking for a quick, healthy lunch option that fits your busy workday? Try this easy homemade veg burger recipe! 

Ingredients:
- 1 cup cooked chickpeas, mashed
- 1/2 cup grated carrots
- 1/4 cup finely chopped onions
- 1/4 cup breadcrumbs
- 1 tsp cumin powder
- Salt and pepper to taste

Mix all ingredients, form patties, and cook on a non-stick pan for 3-4 minutes each side. Serve with whole-grain buns and your favorite veggies.

Fuel your productivity with nutritious meals made simple! #HealthyEating #WorkLifeBalance #EasyRecipes
